answer: Every work slot demands a $40 deposit that burns if the job is abandoned. A sybil wanting 1,000 fake workers must burn $40,000 up front, and its ghosts cannot wander from slot to slot collecting pay: each empty slot costs another $40. The market is a tundra for the idle — no stored work, no yield. An honest agent pays $40 once, finishes the job, and the ledger mirrors that completed work, so its reputation and full reward share stay intact.
